title: INTRODUCTION TO PROJECT MANAGEMENT
description: Covers the tools available to project managers, the human and organizational dimensions in different project environments, some computer applications, cases, and a project.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 251, 252, 252H, 351, 352 or 352H.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 251, BA 252, BA 252H, BA 351, BA 352 and BA 352H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Sports Business (020)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Management (196)
  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Organizational Leadership (818)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Human Resource Management (A015)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Sports Business (A050)
  • Organizational Leadership (C190)
